MASTER-SAAO robotic telescope  [1]  located in South Africa (South African Astronomical Observatory) started inspect of the Fermi GRB261117.91 (trigger No 816645341,06h 17m 16.80s , +41d 39m 36.0s, R=10.83) errorbox  2340 sec after notice time and 2362 sec after trigger time at 2026-11-17 22:34:59 UT, with upper limit up to  17.4 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 78 deg. The sun  altitude  is -38.4 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = 12 deg., longitude l = 172 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3532691
